data.one_liner: Manager for hardware devices and WM_DEVICECHANGE notifications on Windows and Android.
data.what_it_does: Transmits WM_DEVICECHANGE messages to notify Flutter applications when hardware devices are connected or disconnected. It provides a simple listener interface to detect device additions and removals.
use_when: You need to detect when USB or serial devices are plugged in or unplugged on Windows
You are building a Windows desktop Flutter application that interacts with physical hardware
avoid_when: You need cross-platform hardware device management beyond Windows and Android
You require complex serial communication protocols rather than just connection notifications
strengths: Simple listener-based API for handling hardware change events
Native support for Windows WM_DEVICECHANGE messages
weaknesses: Limited documentation and sparse feature set
Platform support is restricted mainly to Windows and Android
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and register the listener after runApp.
